Room.title: Room
Room.description: Real-time multiplayer party game room holding turn state, question pool tracking, special card deck state, switch/double-turn state, and configuration.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the current room host.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the room.

gameNumber.description: Monotonically incremented session counter for Play Again resets.

gameMode.description: Game length mode: rounds (capped at 63 total questions) or all_questions (all 63 questions).

roundsCount.description: Configured number of full rounds (1 to 31, capped so players x rounds <= 63).

randomFirstPlayer.description: Whether the first player order is randomized on game start.

soundEnabled.description: Default sound effects state for the room.

playerOrder.description: Ordered list of player UIDs participating in the room (max 12).

playerCount.description: Number of active players in the room (0 to 12).

currentTurnIndex.description: Zero-based index into playerOrder for the current base turn.

totalTurnsCompleted.description: Total question turns resolved in the current game.

completedQuestionsCount.description: Number of questions answered normally or via Switch/Anti-Switch.

skippedQuestionsCount.description: Number of questions skipped in the current multiplayer game.

currentQuestionId.description: Active official question ID (1 to 63), or null when not playing.

usedQuestionIds.description: List of official question IDs already drawn in the current game (max 63).

activePlayerId.description: UID of the player currently answering or acting, or null.

turnNonce.description: Monotonic counter incremented on every turn or card transition.

turnQuestionsRemaining.description: Consecutive questions left in the current player's turn (1 normally, 2 on 3rd-skip penalty).

switchSourceId.description: UID of player who played a Switch Card on the current question, or null.

switchTargetId.description: UID of targeted player during switch_pending, or null.

availableSpecialCards.description: Remaining un-awarded special card IDs from the 5-card game deck.

awardedCardIds.description: Unique special card IDs already awarded during the current game (max 5).

lastCardEvent.description: Latest special card award or activation event for real-time notifications, or null.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last room mutation.

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Player membership document inside a multiplayer room with score, 3-skip quota, double penalty flags, special card inventory, and voice status.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

avatarColor.description: Gradient palette key for the player avatar.

isHost.description: Whether this player is currently the room host.

score.description: Player score (+1 answer, -3 skip, negative allowed).

skipsRemaining.description: Remaining skips for this player in the current game (0 to 3).

skipsUsed.description: Skips consumed by this player in the current game (0 to 3).

pendingDoubleTurn.description: Whether this player owes two consecutive questions on their next turn after their 3rd skip.

doublePenaltyUsed.description: Whether the one-time double-question penalty has already been triggered.

goldCards.description: Number of unused Gold Cards in this player's inventory (0 to 2).

switchCards.description: Number of unused Switch Cards in this player's inventory (0 to 2).

antiSwitchCards.description: Number of unused Anti-Switch Cards in this player's inventory (0 to 1).

voiceJoined.description: Whether the player is currently connected to the room voice channel.

micMuted.description: Whether the player's microphone is muted in voice chat.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player joined.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest presence heartbeat.

RoomChatMessage.title: RoomChatMessage
RoomChatMessage.description: Real-time text, emoji, or sticker chat message scoped to a single multiplayer room.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Display name of the message author.

text.description: Chat message content or sticker caption placeholder.

stickerId.description: Canonical sticker identifier when messageType is sticker.

stickerUrl.description: HTTPS Firebase Storage download URL of the sticker image.

stickerStoragePath.description: Firebase Storage object path for the sticker image.

stickerCreatorId.description: Original creator UID of the sticker.

stickerCreatorName.description: Original creator display name associated with the sticker.

stickerContentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash used for duplicate prevention.

memberIds.description: Snapshot of room player UIDs permitted to view the message without collection-wide get() reads.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent.

PersonalSticker.title: PersonalSticker
PersonalSticker.description: Personal or saved sticker metadata entry owned by a player (image binary stored in Firebase Storage).

stickerId.description: Canonical sticker ID matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who owns/saved this sticker entry.

creatorName.description: Original creator display name preserved when others save the sticker.

imageUrl.description: HTTPS Firebase Storage download URL of the compressed sticker image.

storagePath.description: Firebase Storage path of the sticker image.

isSavedFromOther.description: True when saved from another player's chat message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when added to the player's collection.

VoiceSignal.title: VoiceSignal
VoiceSignal.description: Ephemeral WebRTC signaling handshake document (SDP offer/answer or ICE candidate) between two room members. No audio is ever stored.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Top-level multiplayer game room documents keyed by 6-character roomCode.

/rooms/{roomId}/players/{playerId}.description: Per-player membership, score, skip counters, special card inventory, and voice mute state.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time text, emoji, and sticker chat messages scoped strictly to room members.

/rooms/{roomId}/voiceSignals/{signalId}.description: Ephemeral WebRTC peer signaling packets for live room voice chat.

/playerStickers/{playerId}/items/{sticke.description: Personal and saved sticker metadata collections owned strictly by each player UID.
